buttons.label: Beside entrance
buttons.script: const slug = [...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id === 'latch-slug'); const door = objects.getAll('castle')[0].entranceDoors[0]; const p = door.entity.getPosition(); slug.entity.rigidbody.teleport(p.x,p.y+0.03,p.z-0.7); slug.testPlayClip('idle_dog'); camera.setViewport({zoom:7,rotation:2,panX:p.x,panZ:p.z-0.7});
